column2: Volt set the scooter's clock right before this test, so the scooter may not be keeping the time it's given. Until that's solved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report an issue with diagnostics so we can look into it.
column3: Volt hat die Uhr des Scooters direkt vor diesem Test gestellt, der Scooter hält die eingestellte Zeit also möglicherweise nicht. Bis das gelöst ist, ist eine smarte Steckdose der sicherere Timer. Nutze „Problem melden“ mit Diagnosedaten, damit wir uns das ansehen können.
column4: Volt set the clock of the scooter directly before this test, so the scooter possibly does not keep the set time. Until that is solved, a smart plug is the safer timer. Use "Report problem" with diagnostic data so that we can look at it.

column2: The battery reached its charge limit during the test, so it couldn't tell. Test again further below the limit.

column4: The battery reached its charge limit during the test, therefore the test could not determine anything. Start the test again with a battery level further below the charge limit.
